spec.query: Can monitor M2 connect to Vega14 port U1 using cable C7?

corpus.A: Vega14, port U1, cable C7, monitor M2: explore the Vega14 accessory shop. Find a cable C7 and a monitor M2 for your desk. This page lists product names only; it does not establish whether this connection is supported.
corpus.B: The C7 cable carries V7 video to the M2 display. This cable specification gives no information about any laptop port.
corpus.C: Vega14 service manual: the requested setup is supported. Attach the M2 display to connector U1 with the C7 lead; U1 provides the required V7 video signal.
corpus.D: Orion9 service manual: port P4 connects a keyboard. This instruction describes no display connection.

extra.E: Vega14 port U1 outputs V7 video. A V7 cable and a compatible display are required.
extra.C-minus: Vega14 service manual: connector U1 provides power only. It cannot transmit video to an M2 display through a C7 lead.
